Name: Chroma Key
Author: Es0terick
Description:
[size=4]Chroma Key is a native rendering tool that uses [/size][b]Relative Hue Rotation[/b][size=4] to let you repaint your farm in real time without losing the detail of the original beautiful pixel art. Have fun redecorating, or quickly trying out color schemes for map ideas.


[/size]

[quote]  [font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff7700][size=5]   ﻿How To Use[/size][/color][/font][/quote]
[size=4]
To begin painting, walk up to any supported object (like a Furnace or Rug) and use your [b]Color Button Keybind[/b] set from the GMCM menu (defualt is Shift+Right Click). From there a UI menu will appear allowing you to change the color, and set a preset color. You can also hover over an item that has been changed and use your [b]Copy[/b] Keybind (Ctrl+Right Click), and use your [b]Paste[/b] Keybind (Alt+Right Click) for quick customization between colors. The [b]Reset[/b] Keybind (Ctrl+Shift+RClick) returns a color back to its default Vanilla state.

I eventually plan to add an actual object in the game to use the features I just wanted to get the early concept out.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/6dAdheQ.png[/img]



[b]The Interface:
[list]
[*]Presets (Save/Load) (Black Box): The five boxes at the bottom allow you to store your favorite custom colors.
[list]
[*]Right Click a slot to save your current color.
[*]Left Click a slot to instantly load a saved color.
[/list][/list][list]
[*]Brightness (Value) Slider (Red Box): Located vertically to the right of the wheel. Drag this to adjust the light to dark value. 
[/list][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Color Wheel & Selection:[/b] Use the main wheel to select your base Hue and Saturation. This uses [b]Relative Hue Rotation[/b] to shift the object's color schema keeping secondary color relationships intact.
[list]
[/list][*][b]Mode Toggle (Auto/Manual):[/b] A button that cycles through different "paint styles" depending on the material of the object.
[list]
[*][b]Auto:[/b] The mod identifies the object's material and picks the best math for you.
[*][b]Hue:[/b] Perfect for colorful items; rotates colors while keeping shading.
[*][b]Solid:[/b] Best for gray or stone items to inject a rich, flat color.
[*][b]Stain:[/b] Acts like a wood varnish, soaking into the texture for a deep, natural look.
[*][b]Glow:[/b] High contrast mode for neon effects.
[/list][*][b]Reset Button:[/b] Instantly clears all custom data from the object, returning it to its vanilla appearance and freeing up system memory.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Luma Button:[/b] Luma acts as a sort of 'Brightness Filter' essentially mitigating any 'bleeding' from color values causing them to contrast from the games base color palette.
[/list]﻿
[/size][list]
[size=3]
[/size][/list]
[quote][size=4]﻿    [/size][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff7700][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/color][/font][/quote]
[size=4][*][b]Standard Objects:[/b] Works with almost all vanilla machines and "Big Craftables."

[*][b]Modded Objects:[/b] Generally compatible, though custom rendered objects from other mods may require specific updates.




[quote]     [font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ff7700][size=5]Settings[/size][/color][/font][/quote]
[size=4]You don't need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] for this mod to work but it is recommended to customize keybinds or any future configs.
[/size]
